findings.title: An Arabic hint on the wrong side of the field
findings.message: The placeholder "مثال: البرشاء، وسط مدينة دبي، دبي مارينا" is Arabic in a left-to-right field.
findings.fix: Keep dir="ltr" for what people type, and right-align the Arabic hint with input:placeholder-shown { direction: rtl } or ::placeholder { text-align: right }.
findings.snippet: <input type="text" id="area" name="area" class="field-input" dir="auto" placeholder="مثال: البرشاء، وسط مدينة دبي، دبي مارينا" autocomplete="address-level2" req

findings.title: Two digit systems on one screen
findings.message: "٣٠ دقيقة" uses a different digit system from the rest of the screen.
findings.fix: Pick one digit system for the product and format every number with it.

findings.title: Spacing that does not mirror
findings.message: padding-right: 14px stays on the same side in Arabic.
findings.fix: Use margin-inline-start, padding-inline-end and the other logical properties.
